messages:
maria: Quick coordination — planning a small engine+quant profile push tomorrow 09:00 PST. Kernel v2.3.5 + quant profile q8b-v3. Can someone take deploy owner and run the 30m smoke window?

devon: I can own the deploy and do the first 30m smoke. Will check tail latency, mem, and kv-cache warmup. Need the exact canary target group.

maria: Canary group is rg-runtime-canary-usw2 (30 instances). Console link: https://console.redwood/runtime/deploys/rg-runtime-canary-usw2

sree: I can be rollback lead and on-call during the window. Rollback criteria proposal: >1% OOM or median token latency increase >25% over baseline for 10m. Agree?

jamie: Agree on criteria. Code review for the kernel bump is done (PR #4821). Small doc change pending in docs/quant-profiles.md — I'll merge before deploy.

olga: infra build finished for the kernel artifact, signed and pushed to registry (sha: f2a9c3). Noted the quant profile artifact too.

devon: Smoke checklist (short):
1) start-up logs: no ERROR in first 2m
2) health endpoints OK /health -> {status: "ok"}
3) perf: median token latency < 150ms, p95 < 300ms
4) memory: host RSS below 85% of allocation
5) functional: run prompt set v2 and compare outputs diff rate < 2%
6) kv-cache warmup: hit rate > 60% after 10k requests

devon: Smoke run command (local):
```bash
./tools/smoke-run --env=canary --profile=q8b-v3 --duration=15m --prom-url=https://prom.redwood
```

sree: I'll validate rollback command beforehand:
```bash
./deploy/rollback --cluster=rg-runtime-canary-usw2 --to=sha:f1b2c3
```
Rollback tested on staging — confirmed to restore previous kernel and quant profile within ~90s.

maria: Nice. Who will post status updates to #support during the window so support can triage user-facing issues?

support-bot: I can auto-post start/finish messages to #support when the deploy begins/ends. Please set the deploy flag in the deploy tool.

devon: I'll post manual notes too and pin the smoke checklist. Plan: start canary at 09:00 PST, monitor for 30m, then expand to 200 instances if green. If any of the hard criteria fail, we rollback immediately and notify #eng-oncall.

jamie: Reminder: the PR includes a small cfg change for kernel threadpool settings. Keeping the pool conservative for canary to avoid contention.

olga: I'll keep an eye on infra alerts (OOM killer, node disk, docker restarts). Will escalate if anything odd.

maria: Perfect. Pre-deploy checklist: jamie merge docs, olga confirm artifact, sree validate rollback, devon owns smoke, i'll update runbook and trigger the deploy.

devon: One more ask — please grant me temporary deploy permission for the canary group (expires after deploy). @people-ops / @security can you approve?

maria: @people-ops please approve deploy permission for devon for the 3h window.

ops-bot: Deploy permission request created: ticket #DEP-2194 (pending approval).

support-bot: I'll post this thread summary to #support now: canary 09:00 PST, owner devon, rollback lead sree, watch perf and memory.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll run final preflight at 08:30 PST and post the go/no-go. If nothing else, see you tomorrow. :thumbsup:
